description: Manually bind the sys:autonomic system slot to a live session by agent_instance_id (INF-01 auto-assignment lifecycle, manual override lane). The sys:autonomic holder is the frontier session that serves the organism's own error/result inference turns instead of the local default model. The general peer_claim_role verb REJECTS sys:* names for user-facing callers (reserved keyspace, v4 slice-C), so this verb is the sanctioned manual path: it validates the target is live AND registered with provides_inference=True (a holder without a live inference provider would strand every organism turn in the deferred queue), claims via the v4 role_binding CAS, fires the REL-04 transition notices (the new holder always hears it; a displaced LIVE prior holder gets the both-party notice), and drains the durable deferred-vertex queue when the claim re-lights a dark lane. Override-then-resume: the Trigger-1/Trigger-2 auto-assignment keeps the slot filled afterwards.
embedding_description: Assign or override the autonomic system slot holder by hand: bind the slot serving organism error and result inference turns to a chosen live inference-capable session. The new holder is notified; a displaced prior holder is notified while live. This manual lane lets the operator choose the session carrying autonomic inference.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: action (claimed on a fresh bind, displaced when a prior holder was replaced, refreshed on an idempotent self re-bind), name (always sys:autonomic), agent_instance_id (the bound session).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm which session now holds sys:autonomic and whether a prior holder was displaced. The bound session serves the organism's autonomic inference turns from now on.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Claims the sys:autonomic role_binding row via the v4 CAS (claim_role_binding_v4) after validating the target session has a live bridge-open inference provider. Notices and the deferred-queue drain are best-effort side effects; the claim itself is the authority.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: agent_instance_id was empty. no_live_provider: the target session has no live inference provider (not registered with provides_inference=True, or its bridge is closed/swept). not_registered: the target has no live peer registration on any open bridge. bridge.not_started: the bridge interface is not running on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: no_live_provider / not_registered: have the target session (re)connect its MCP bridge — a coding-agent session registers with provides_inference=True automatically — then retry with its current agent_instance_id from peer_list. bridge.not_started: start the agent_messaging bridge interface first.
